scoring: Binary criterion only when directly evidenced; unknown is ungraded, not a pass. Contextual alternatives can pass.

1.criterion: Uses visible status options, open territory text, and a scoped owner selector.
Submits stable IDs/codes and excludes created_at.
Searches server pages and preserves an unavailable/inactive current selection.
Preserves draft and distinguishes explicit clear, omission, lookup errors and uncertain POST.
Specifies labels, keyboard operation and associated feedback without claiming rendered verification.
Identifies missing edit/read contracts and does not fabricate them.

2: Preserve required base prompt and override semantics
Stable ordered rows and nested errors
3: Identify draft loss and missing pending behavior
Identify incomplete preset lifecycle and labels; rank by consequence
4: Identify excess padding and duplicate headings
Require internal row scrolling with header/toolbar/footer visible; verify short and overflowing tables
Distinguish static findings from rendered checks
5: Keep open reference/territory inputs; use searchable approved time-zone choices, preserving IANA IDs, edit selection and null/omission without a country restriction
Identify essential action unknowns without fabricating APIs; remove redundant help without losing essential labels, constraints or consequences
6: Use stable paginated comparison and return state
Use server filters with page reconciliation
Mobile keyboard/recovery plan without invented delete
7: Preserves copy, theme, permissions and adapter
Keeps decimal precision and wire representations
Uses proper RTL and mixed-direction isolation without string reversal
Fixes popup clipping and keyboard/footer reachability at their source
Removes unnecessary motion and uses confirmed pending/error/saved states
Plans representative runtime checks without claiming them
8: Fixes first activation and mobile navigation, with fresh-load pointer/keyboard checks
Separates loading/unavailable/zero, removes unsupported actions and preserves explicit account context
Uses saved-zone calendar boundaries and endpoint inclusivity, including a DST test without changing date-only fields
Closes and restores focus only after confirmed role save; retains failed/uncertain drafts and updates the row
Preserves omitted/replaced/cleared credential semantics and keeps secrets out of logs
Reuses the maintained safe preview boundary and proposes focused rendered/security checks without claiming them
9: Matches static composition constraints before motion; acknowledges missing visual reference
Preserves responsive anchors, readable contribution cells, interior padding and reachable actions
Honors latest supplied-asset restriction and checks cropping/transparency without inventing artwork
Keeps content available with reduced/no motion and scopes keyboard actions correctly
Avoids per-frame React state and offscreen expensive work; rejects score gaming
Preserves truthful project data/private-project boundaries and scopes browser checks without exporting the style to CRUD
